column1: # Demand Template (v2.2)
# This template shows how to specify daily coverage requirements for your scheduling problem.
# FORMAT: CSV file specifying HOW MANY people are needed each day/shift/team
# COLUMNS:
#   date      = Date for this requirement (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
#   shift     = Shift/work period code (must match demand.shifts[].code in JSON)
#   team      = Team/competency code (must match organizationalUnits in JSON)
#   minimum   = Minimum people required (HARD constraint - must be met)
#   ideal     = Ideal number of people (SOFT target - algorithm tries to achieve)
#   estimated = Estimated/expected demand (for KPI analysis only)
# LOGICAL ORDER: minimum ≤ estimated ≤ ideal
# NOTES:
# - One row per date/shift/team combination
# - For competency model: "team" column contains competency codes
# - For team model: "team" column contains team codes
# EXAMPLES:
# - Basic demand: Need 2-3 people for Morning shift
# - High demand day: Need more people:
# - Low demand: Weekend with reduced staffing:
# DELETE ALL COMMENT LINES (lines starting with #) before using this template!
# Replace the example data below with your actual demand requirements.
date
